The '''Cult of the Screaming Blade''' was formed by the renegade [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Paladius]] during the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. Based on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]], it was usurped by the [[Sith Inquisitor]], [[Darth Nox|Kallig]], during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. During the [[Galactic War]], Kallig returned in search of a [[CN-12 sensor chip]] to test their new weapon, the [[Silencer (superweapon)|Silencer]]. The Cult helped to track it down.
